We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule (target) reproduces the reaction: aromatic amine attacks electrophilic sulfur of phenylsulfonyl chloride, then collapse to expel Cl- and base deprotonates N-H to give sulfonamide. So functional group formed: sulfonamide (N-S bond). Broken bond: S-Cl bond. So forward reaction: sulfonyl chloride + amine -> sulfonamide + HCl (or base). In retrosynthesis, we break N-S bond and form S-Cl bond (i.e., we go from sulfonamide to sulfonyl chloride + amine). So we need a template that breaks N-S bond and forms S-Cl bond. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_formed? Actually forward reaction forms sulfonamide (functional group formed) and breaks S-Cl. So in forward reaction, functional_groups_formed includes "sulfonamide"? The list of functional groups likely includes "sulfonamide". We need to search for templates where functional_groups_formed includes "sulfonamide" and bonds_broken includes "S-Cl". Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria.

Let's call search with molecule SMILES = given. functional_groups_formed=["sulfonamide"]; bonds_broken=["S-Cl"] maybe format "S-Cl"? The tool expects bond types like "6-6" etc. Not sure. Might be "S-Cl". Could try.
